landing.heroSub: WinKit is a calibration bench for everyday files: convert, compress and inspect with exact readouts - entirely inside your browser. No uploads, no ads, no guessing what came out.
landing.p1d: Drag & drop or pick files. WinKit checks extension, MIME and magic bytes - renamed malware is refused at the door.
landing.p2d: Quality presets, dimensions, page ranges, timestamps. Every converter shows only the controls it needs.
landing.p3d: Preview, download one file or everything as ZIP. History keeps the receipt, never the content.
landing.dirSub: Click any tool to open it directly in the app.
landing.closeSub: One bench in your browser. Quick, clean, private - down to the byte.
web.tag: web app · files stay in your browser
err.offline: You are offline. OCR needs internet once to download language data, then works offline.
